headline.purpose: Page title (h1) at the top of each tab, one per view.

title.purpose: Card and section headings (panel title, chart heading, list section heading).

body.purpose: Page-heading descriptive copy and general prose, capped near 46ch.

label.purpose: Field labels and small metadata captions.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: The single resting elevation shadow, applied to every card, entry panel, and form card.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft green halo on focused inputs; a state treatment rather than resting elevation.

shadows.name: chart-tooltip
shadows.purpose: Recharts tooltip popover shadow, slightly stronger than the ambient card shadow for a floating element.

shadows.name: segmented-tab
shadows.purpose: Small lift on the active/hovered pill inside the Weight/BMI/Waistline metric-tab track; marks selection, not resting elevation.

motion.name: page-enter
motion.purpose: Shared fade+rise entrance for every page/tab switch.

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: Habit progress bar fill transform transition.

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus color and border transitions across buttons and inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid accent submit button used to commit a form (add entry, add habit, save profile).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #1b7f4d; color: #fff; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #176642; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35, 139, 90, 0.14); }

components.name: Small Danger Button
components.description: Row-level destructive action (delete a weight entry, archive a habit).
components.css: .ds-btn-sm-danger { min-width: 30px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #f0d4d4; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #b84c4c; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-sm-danger:hover { border-color: #b84c4c; background: #fff1f1; } .ds-btn-sm-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b84c4c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard labeled numeric/text field used across weight, habit, and profile forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: #63756b; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 13px; border: 1px solid #c8d9cd; border-radius: 10px; outline: none; background: #ffffff; color: #193025; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1b7f4d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35, 139, 90, 0.14); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base raised container used for chart, list, form, and habit surfaces.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #dce8df; border-radius: 18px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(25, 48, 37, 0.06); padding: 26px; } .ds-card-title { color: #193025; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 720; margin: 0; } .ds-card-copy { color: #63756b; font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Tab Navigation Item
components.description: Header tab button with a green underline indicating the active/hovered view.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; height: 78px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #63756b; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: transparent; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab-active { color: #176642; } .ds-tab-active::after { background: #1b7f4d; }

components.name: Habit Progress Bar
components.description: Signature component: a pill-shaped track showing today's progress toward a habit's daily target.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 7px; border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; background: #e6f3eb; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #1b7f4d; transform: scaleX(var(--ds-progress, 0)); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }

components.name: Segmented Metric Tabs
components.description: Three-way Weight/BMI/Waistline switcher on the You trend card; a subtle-surface track holding equal-width pill buttons.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #dce8df; border-radius: 10px; background: #fbfdfb; } .ds-segmented-tab { flex: 1; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #63756b; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented-tab:hover, .ds-segmented-tab-active { background: #ffffff; color: #176642; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(25, 48, 37, 0.06); }

narrative.overview: Slog reads as a single calm instrument, not a dashboard: one primary green, one work surface per tab, and a heading that leads straight into its task. The build follows the direction contract's own-world (warm white surfaces, forest-green ink, thin botanical borders, quiet shadows, practical line icons) closely — every surface is `--surface: #ffffff` on a barely-tinted `--bg: #f7faf7`, every border is a hairline `1px solid var(--border)`, and every shadow is a single soft, low-opacity ambient glow rather than a directional or offset shadow. Icons are hand-drawn inline SVG strokes (1.8px stroke, 17–18px box) for user/chart/check/lock/plus — never glyph icon fonts. Density is spacious and generous: cards carry 26–28px internal padding, the page shell runs on a 1180px-capped centered rail, and vertical rhythm between page sections is a wide 20–28px gap. Typography does the hierarchy work instead of color or multiple type families: one font stack throughout, differentiated by precise non-standard weight steps (650/720/750/760) and tight negative letter-spacing on the largest sizes, never by switching typeface.
keyCharacteristics: Single-hue forest-green accent used sparingly against warm white and pale-green neutrals
One font family for the entire interface; hierarchy comes from size, weight, and letter-spacing only
Flat, hairline-bordered cards lifted only by one soft ambient shadow, never a hard or offset one
Inline stroke-SVG line icons only, never glyph icon fonts
Generous, uncluttered spacing with a task-first page composition and responsive entry/chart grid per tab

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Forest Green is the only saturated color in the system. Every other color is either a neutral (white/warm-white/ink/muted) or the single functional red reserved for destructive actions. No second brand accent exists.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every text role uses the same font stack. Emphasis is achieved only through weight (650–800), size, and negative letter-spacing at large sizes — never a secondary display face.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one resting elevation shadow in the system, applied identically to every card-like surface. The chart tooltip and the segmented metric-tab's active-state shadow are the explicit transient exceptions; depth differences between resting elements are expressed by border and background only, not by shadow variation.

dos: Do keep the interface to one saturated accent (Forest Green); use its soft/wash tonal steps for backgrounds only, never for text or borders.
Do use the single Ambient Card shadow (`0 14px 40px rgba(25, 48, 37, 0.06)`) plus a hairline border for every raised surface — don't invent a second shadow depth.
Do build hierarchy with this one font family's weight and size steps (650–800 for emphasis) rather than introducing a second typeface.
Do draw icons as inline stroke SVGs (1.8px stroke, ~18px box) matching the existing user/chart/check/lock/plus set.
Do reserve the red danger color strictly for destructive row actions (delete, archive), never for warnings or emphasis.
Do preserve the shipped accessibility state model: `aria-current` for tabs, `aria-pressed` for the privacy toggle, explicit sync labels/titles, and polite live status updates.
donts: Don't introduce a hard-edged or offset drop shadow anywhere — this is a soft-ambient-shadow, hairline-border world, not a neobrutalist one.
Don't add a second brand accent color; every non-neutral, non-danger color in this system is a tonal step of the one Forest Green.
Don't use glyph icon fonts or raster icon images; the system's icons are hand-authored stroke SVGs.
Don't hide the sync control's accessible name when compacting the header; only its visible text label is removed at the small breakpoint.
